mostWorthwhile.text: Making the contracting young Sun was most worthwhile: it clarified that accretion and contraction can power its light before sustained hydrogen fusion.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to combine the cavity with the young Sun was frustrating: the cavity was described as a path for light, but had no available combinations.

surprise.text: I expected hydrogen to trigger sustained fusion, but the young Sun was still powered by contraction and accretion.

arbitrary.text: The cavity seemed like a natural way to help sunlight escape, so its lack of any available combination felt somewhat arbitrary.

continue.text: Yes. I would choose to continue to see how the disk’s inherited dust and ice become worlds, especially after the useful distinction between the young Sun’s light and fusion.
